metadata.analyst_directive: Client Q10: focus on 4 newly-added products (folding arm awning, BBQ pods, smart outdoor TV, U7 smartoilet) 'as well' — additive to the pergola core, no per-product split specified. Delivery brief: find quick wins through GSC. Analyst-approved split (2026-07-01): 6 new-product + 4 pergola-net-new (2 untracked GSC quick-wins + 2 QLD geo-expansion). Deduped against the 20 tracked pergola/louvre keywords.

strategic_narratives.title: New-product pages already rank but are keyword-starved
strategic_narratives.summary: u7-smartoilet ranks GSC pos 5.95 and delta-commercial-folding-arm pos 5.47, yet both draw ~0 clicks — they rank invisibly because nothing targets the terms. 6 of 10 keywords are structured as existing-page-optimisation to convert these latent rankings into traffic fastest.

strategic_narratives.title: The real GSC quick-wins are untracked pergola terms
strategic_narratives.summary: The biggest striking-distance GSC opportunities are NOT in the tracked 20: pergola melbourne (5,038 impr, pos 16.6) and pergola sydney (2,154 impr, pos 9.3). Per the delivery brief, 2 slots capture these; 2 more open QLD (untapped).

strategic_narratives.title: QLD demand is thin — 'louvre roof' held in reserve
strategic_narratives.summary: Brisbane pergola volume tops out at pergola brisbane 390/mo (variants <=40). The 2 QLD slots are a strategic beachhead, not a traffic driver. If the analyst prefers volume, swap 'pergola kits brisbane' (40/mo) for the national on-brand 'louvre roof' (1,300/mo, score 0.707) held in reserve.

strategic_narratives.title: Two strategic bets need 6-12 months
strategic_narratives.summary: bidet toilet (9,900/mo) and retractable awning (6,600/mo) are category umbrella terms — big prizes but, at DA 16 against category-focused incumbents, they are 6-12 month category-page builds, paired with the exact-match quick-wins (smart toilet, folding arm awning) for near-term ROI.

metadata.local_signal_directive: NEW-PRODUCT PAGES: Skyflex is Melbourne-based (Epping showroom) but ships AU-wide, and geo-modified new-product terms are ~0/mo (outdoor tv melbourne 0, bbq pod melbourne 0, smart toilet melbourne 50) — so primaries are national heads. Capture the Melbourne edge WITHOUT wasting slots: (1) +melbourne/+australia variants as secondaries [added], (2) LocalBusiness schema + 'visit our Epping showroom' trust block per product page, (3) Melbourne mentions in copy — helps the bare term auto-localise for Melbourne searchers. PERGOLA pages are already geo-targeted (real geo demand: pergola melbourne/sydney 1,300/mo each).
metadata.geo_strategy_note: Analyst decision 2026-07-01: ALL new-product primaries geo/national-qualified (winnable-first for DA 16 — client ranks for NONE of the bare heads: current_position None + ~0 GSC impr). Bare heads retained as aspirational secondaries on each page. This trades raw reach (24,840→5,770/mo) for rankable targets.

general_keywords.reasoning: 880/mo national-qualified head. CORRECTION vs earlier draft: the client does NOT rank for the bare 'smart toilet' (2,400) — current_position None (not top-50), ~0 GSC impressions for the head (the u7-smartoilet page's GSC avg-position reflected long-tail/brand queries, not this keyword). At DA 16 with no foothold, the winnable target is 'smart toilet australia'. Phase 3c bare-term SERP is .com.au retailers (smarttoiletaustralia.com.au, tradelink.com.au, johnsonsuisse.com.au); the qualified SERP is less contested. U7 is a full integrated smart toilet + 'up to 8x cheaper' USP. Action: optimise /product/u7-smartoilet/ for 'smart toilet australia' + LocalBusiness/Epping-showroom trust; bare 'smart toilet' (2,400) is the aspirational secondary. Page-1 realistic 3-6 months.

390/mo. The bare 'bidet toilet' (9,900) is owned by dedicated AU bidet specialists (bidetwarehouse.com.au, bidetsonline.com.au, thebidetshop.com.au) — not winnable for a DA-16 new entrant inside 12 months, so target the qualified 'bidet toilet australia'. Skyflex's U7 Smartoilet is an integrated bidet toilet; European design + 8x-cheaper USPs differentiate. Action: build a /smart-toilets/ category page for the qualified term + FAQ from the 4 PAA; bare 'bidet toilet' (9,900) is the long-term aspirational secondary. Page-1 for the qualified term realistic 4-6 months.

170/mo local head. CORRECTION: the client does NOT rank for the bare 'folding arm awning' (1,600) — current_position None, ~0 GSC impressions for the head (the delta-commercial-folding-arm page's avg-position was long-tail/brand, not this keyword). Given the Melbourne base + Epping showroom, the local term (MEDIUM competition vs HIGH on the bare) is the winnable entry. Phase 3c bare-term SERP is .com.au awning retailers (halfpriceblinds.com.au, luxaflex.com.au, franklyn.net.au). European-designed, customisable, 8x-cheaper Delta Commercial range + local showroom is the wedge. Action: optimise /product/delta-commercial-folding-arm/ for the Melbourne term + LocalBusiness schema; bare 'folding arm awning' (1,600) is the aspirational secondary. Local page-1 realistic 3-5 months.

320/mo local head. The bare 'retractable awning' (6,600) SERP is luxiliving.com.au (a Phase 3b competitor), budgetawnings.com.au, helioscreen.com.au — a category front too steep for DA 16 short-term, so target 'retractable awning melbourne'. Folding-arm awnings are the premium type of retractable awning; Delta Commercial range + Melbourne showroom differentiates. Action: build a /retractable-awnings/ page with a Melbourne focus + LocalBusiness signals; bare 'retractable awning' (6,600) is the aspirational secondary. Local page-1 realistic 4-6 months.

590/mo national-qualified head — the winnable entry into outdoor TV for a DA-16 own-brand, chosen over bare 'outdoor tv' (2,900) on purpose. Phase 3c shows the bare-term SERP is Harvey Norman + Sylvox (brand) + an AI Overview — a 12-month climb at DA 16; the qualified term and long-tail 'weatherproof outdoor tv' (secondaries) sit on less retailer-locked .com.au SERPs. Skyflex's 4K Android Smart Outdoor TV is weatherproof/full-sun and own-brand ('up to 8x cheaper' USP) — the wedge against Harvey Norman's Samsung/Sylvox stock. Action: optimise /product/skyflex-4k-android-smart-outdoor-tv/ + a /outdoor-tvs/ category with a weatherproof buying guide, LocalBusiness + 'visit our Epping showroom' trust signals, and the 4 PAA; the bare 'outdoor tv' (2,900) is the aspirational secondary the page grows into as authority builds. Page-1 for the qualified term realistic in 4-6 months.

390/mo national-qualified. bbq pod (720 bare) is an emerging term (+268% YoY); the 'australia' qualifier is a cleaner-intent national target. Phase 3c SERP is fragmented .com.au outdoor retailers (expressportables.com.au, outdoorlivinghq.com.au) — no PAA, no dominant player, a low-competition land-grab either way. Own-brand enclosed BBQ Pods + European design suit the premium alfresco buyer. Action: optimise /product/skyflex-bbq-pods/ for 'bbq pod australia' + support with 'outdoor bbq area'/'bbq shelter' (secondaries); bare 'bbq pod' is a secondary. Rising term, high defensibility.

A CONFIRMED GSC quick win NOT in the tracked 20: 1,300/mo, GSC pos 9.3 on 2,154 impressions/90d, and /louvred-pergolas-sydney/ already ranks (74 clicks/90d). Phase 3c SERP is local Sydney pergola specialists (pergolaland.com.au, sydneypergolaservices.com.au, pergolux.au) with a local pack — but Skyflex already sits page 1, so this is an optimisation push, not a build. The European-designed motorised louvred range + Epping showroom credibility differentiates from local installers. Action: strengthen the existing Sydney page (title/H1, internal links from the pergola cluster, 4 PAA as FAQ) to lift pos 9 to top-5. Exactly the GSC quick win the brief asked for, and additive to the tracked 20.

The single biggest untapped impression prize: GSC pos 16.6 on 5,038 impressions/90d (the 'Louvred Pergolas Melbourne' homepage + /outdoor-pergolas/ rank here) — NOT in the tracked 20. At pos 16.6 it is page-2, just outside the strict quick-win band, but 5,038 impressions means a lift to page 1 unlocks major traffic. Phase 3c SERP is value pergola retailers (affordablepergolas.com.au, pergolux.au, cosydeals.com.au) + local pack — beatable with Skyflex's premium European louvred positioning and Epping showroom E-E-A-T that 'affordable/cosy deals' players cannot match. Action: give Melbourne a dedicated pergola landing page (the homepage currently double-duties) with the louvred range, price table and PAA FAQ to move pos 16 to page 1 over 3-5 months. Highest-impression lever in the set.

QLD geo-expansion of a proven template. 390/mo — modest (QLD demand is genuinely thinner than Melb/Syd, flagged in strategic_narratives), but the client lists Queensland as a target area (Q11) and has ZERO current QLD presence (no GSC impressions). Phase 3c SERP is local Brisbane specialists (pergolasbrisbane.com.au, apollopatios.com.au) + luxiliving.com.au (a Phase 3b competitor) — no client footprint to defend, pure greenfield. Skyflex already ranks pos 7-16 for pergola terms in Melb/Syd, proving the louvred-pergola content template works; replicating it for Brisbane (with national DIY-kit shipping + installer network) plants the QLD flag. Action: create a /pergolas-brisbane/ landing page mirroring the Sydney template. Low volume, low competition, net-new — a strategic beachhead, not a traffic driver.

The DIY-kit angle of the QLD play. 40/mo — low volume (honestly flagged), currently GSC pos 49 on 28 impressions, effectively unranked. But Skyflex's core model IS nationally-shipped DIY pergola kits, so a Brisbane kit-buyer searching this can actually convert (unlike a fixed-install competitor). Phase 3c SERP is kit retailers (smartkits.com.au, gardenenvi.com, modaprax.com.au) — .com.au product sellers, Shopping present, no local-install lock — precisely where Skyflex's shippable kit + 'up to 8x cheaper' pricing wins. Action: extend the /pergola-kits/ page with a Brisbane/QLD shipping section rather than a heavy new build. Lowest-volume pick, justified only as the DIY-kit complement to 'pergola brisbane'; the analyst may prefer to swap this slot for the national 'louvre roof' (1,300/mo) held in reserve.
